notes: eq-intake (repo eq-solutions/eq-intake, renamed 2026-09-20 from eq-solves-intake) — 4 clean manual fleet cycles observed 2026-06-30 (PRs #48/#50/#51/#52). eq-intake is a pnpm-workspace LIBRARY with NO root package.json: the build lives in eq-platform/. Gate (build) = `pnpm -C eq-platform check:packages` (schemas:lint + lib build + typecheck over packages/* — excludes eq-format-ui + eq-intake-demo which are Vite apps needing external @eq-solutions/* packages not installed here). Test gate = `pnpm -C eq-platform test` (unit only; `test:integration` @eq/ai is a separate known-flaky integration suite, excluded). `run` is empty — library, no dev server. autoMerge stays false. publicIntake + lighthouse auto-dispatch off. To arm crows-nest /loop: export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="$(pwd)/.claude/armada" in the terminal before launching claude — see .armada/SETUP-NOTES.md.
